role_in_parent: Convert the endpoint values m/n into a combinatorial residue sum that can be estimated term-by-term.
statement_nl: For every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1, let r_k be the least nonnegative residue of k*m modulo n for each k = 1, ..., n. Then F_n(m/n) = sum_{k=1}^n r_k/(n*k).

domain_restrictions: n is a positive integer (so modulo n and the least nonnegative residue are well-defined)
m is an integer satisfying 0 <= m <= n - 1
k ranges over all integers from 1 to n inclusive
each r_k is the least nonnegative residue, hence lies in the set of integers {0, 1, 2, ..., n - 1}
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n and every integer m with 0 <= m <= n - 1, if for each k in {1, 2, ..., n} the integer r_k is defined as the least nonnegative residue of k*m modulo n, then F_n evaluated at m/n equals the sum from k = 1 to n of r_k divided by n times k.
quantifier_order: for every integer m with 0 <= m <= n - 1
for each integer k with 1 <= k <= n
define r_k as the least nonnegative residue of k*m modulo n
conclude the equality for that m (and the resulting r_k values)

variables.name: n
variables.role: modulus parameter and index for the function F_n and the range of k

variables.name: m
variables.role: input numerator determining the rational number m/n

variables.name: k
variables.role: summation/index variable and parameter for the residues

variables.name: r_k
variables.role: least nonnegative residue of k*m modulo n; depends on k, m, n

variables.domain: rationals of the form m/n with 0 <= m <= n - 1
variables.name: F_n
variables.role: target function evaluated at the rational m/n

witness_dependencies: r_k depends on the chosen n and m and on the index k
the equality value F_n(m/n) depends on the whole list of residues r_1, ..., r_n, which in turn are determined by n and m
